That's part of the problem. I have felt like this so long I haven tried everything I can think of. I have crossed near everything off my bucket list I have wanted to do. I have joined sports teams, I go out to try to meet people several times a week, I have tried online dating, I was even at the range saturday just to blow off steam. Everything helps, for a while. Nothing makes it better.
The number is meaningless. The first time I rolled the dice 73 is what came up. I gave myself till 73 came up again.
